description:
Parsed git diff (staged or worktree): files + hunks (old_start/lines, new_start/lines, section). Patch text is opt-in via include_patch=true.
Use when: you need per-file hunk info for review/preview or a test, not free text.
Avoid when: you need a raw unified blob (use include_patch=true or diff_files) or a PR diff (provider tools).
Output: files[] {old_path|null, new_path|null, action (added|modified|deleted|renamed), binary, hunks[] {old_start, old_lines, new_start, new_lines, section}}, counts{}, patch_bytes, patch/patch_truncated when include_patch=true.

include_patch.description: true includes the unified diff text (truncated to max_bytes).

paths.description: Optional workspace-relative paths to limit the diff.

staged.description: true compares the index to HEAD (git diff --cached); false compares worktree to HEAD/index.
